author: Keetdz
quote:
Dad of 3D games
Ocarina of Time isn't just a great 1998 game; it's one of the best games ever made, period. Unmatched atmosphere, iconic music, brilliant dungeon design, and mechanics that shaped the entire industry. A timeless 10/10 masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Keetdz
quote: So much budget and so many years of development just to deliver a broken game at launch. GTA VI has an incredible foundation, but the constant bugs, crashes, and terrible optimization completely ruin the experience. We expected a polished masterpiece and got an unfinished product instead. Very disappointing.
